description:
Migrate the polynomial crossover selector family to read the tuning profile, with the current constant values as the embedded defaults.

## Background

The migrated selector family is the Karatsuba, subproduct-tree, NTT, and division crossover constants in `crates/gf2-core/src/field/poly.rs`, as marked profile-scoped by the capability classification. Under the default profile the selected values equal the current constants, so behavior is unchanged by construction; the scalar fallback paths stay reachable. Remaining profile-scoped constants migrate in follow-on work once the pilot receipt is recorded.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The selectors read their values from the loaded profile, and tests show selection equals the pre-cutover constants under the default profile.
- [hard] REQ-02: A non-default profile measurably changes the selected route in a test, and the scalar fallback path remains reachable and tested.
title: Cut the polynomial crossover selectors over to profile-driven selection
